home.heroTitle: Helping IT Professionals Build Careers in Malta
home.introTitle: Mentoring for IT Professionals Relocating to Malta
home.introText: Whether you are considering a move to Malta or already here, I offer practical mentoring focused on the local IT job market: from CV and LinkedIn optimisation to interview preparation and relocation advice. My goal is to help you land a role that fits your skills and ambitions.
home.ctaTitle: Ready to take the next step?

about.title: About
about.introShort: SRE and DevOps engineer in Malta, mentoring IT professionals who want to build their careers here.
story: I have been living in Malta for three years. I work as an SRE / DevOps engineer, supporting systems and platforms that need to stay reliable in fast-moving environments.

Over that time I have worked in different sectors and roles—from startups to more established companies. That variety gave me exposure to how teams hire, how interviews are structured, and what employers in Malta actually look for beyond buzzwords on a CV.

I mentor IT professionals who want to find a job here or take the next step in their career. My aim is to share what I have learned first-hand: how to present your experience clearly, prepare for technical and behavioural interviews, and understand the local job market with realistic expectations.
If you are planning to relocate or are already on the island and want structured guidance, I would be glad to help you move forward with clarity and confidence.
